sources.name: Toronto Public Library - Newcomer events (BiblioCommons)
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-06 (combines the events search at tpl.bibliocommons.com/v2/events?q=newcomer and the general landing page at tpl.ca/using-the-library/new-to-canada/, which just links to the same search - not a second feed). BiblioCommons confirmed to return real, dated newcomer-focused programming across many branches (English Conversation Circles, Newcomer Settlement Services, Citizenship Education Circles) but no public JSON/REST endpoint was found on a first pass, so events were hand-entered from the rendered page. A native BiblioCommons parser (same idea as parse_communico for libnet) would be worth building given how much real content is here.

sources.name: Bayview Glen Church
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-06. Squarespace; ?format=json is blocked by robots.txt (unlike Knox Toronto's, which allows it) so no feed access - hand-entered from the rendered events page instead. sources.name: Settlement.Org - Events (Ontario)
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-06. Static HTML listing, RSS feed mentioned in the footer but no JSON/REST API found. Most of the rest of the list is province-wide webinars without a confirmed Toronto tie, left out.

sources.notes: Added 2026-09-06. WordPress, wp-json/tribe route 404s. sources.name: Destination Toronto - Events
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-06. Events are rendered through a third-party widget (destinationtoronto.cruncho.co) with no exposed JSON/REST API found. Distillery Historic District, Nov 12 2026 - Jan 3 2027 (tree lighting Nov 12, 6pm).
